briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026. Sources are limited to the search results provided. Where a result gave only a headline, I cite the page where that headline appeared.

**Snapshot:** Infosys is a Bangalore-headquartered IT services company with over 325,000 employees across 59 countries (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece). Its Q2 results drove most of the recent news, and the stock fell after them.

## What changed

**Results and guidance**
- Q2 revenue was $5,145M. Reported revenue rose 1.3% YoY, constant-currency growth was 1.5% YoY and 1.2% QoQ, and operating margin was 21.0% (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- AI revenue grew 29% sequentially and made up 10.5% of revenue (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- Infosys lowered its annual revenue growth guidance. The ADR fell over 7% on 23 Oct (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325).
- Shares fell 6.5% after Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01 (27 Oct headline, https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- Shares slid over 2% on 2 Nov, and the Hyderabad campus expansion did not lift sentiment (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).
- Headline-only items on the same page: BMO Capital raised its price target to $13 and kept a Market Perform rating (26 Oct), and North America revenue declined amid sector slowdowns (23 Oct) (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).

**Deals**
- Large-deal total contract value reached $5.2B, of which 62% was net new, including one deal above $2B (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).

**Hires and capacity**
- Infosys expanded its Truist GCC in India and onboarded 1,000 colleagues (19 Oct headline, https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- A new 1.1M sq ft block opened at the Pocharam campus in Hyderabad to serve emerging technologies (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms).
- The Hyderabad inauguration was attended by Telangana's Deputy Chief Minister, the IT Minister, and CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka. The facility targets banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).

**Investor relations and market activity**
- Management will attend non-deal investor roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November. The excerpt does not give the dates (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- A block trade of ₹69.49 crore was executed on NSE on 23 Oct (headline, https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).

**Other**
- The Infosys Prize 2026 winners were announced on 12 Nov in Bengaluru. Each winner receives USD 100,000 (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners).

**Source gaps:** The results contain no launch announcements beyond the Hyderabad capacity expansion and no hiring data beyond the Truist GCC onboarding. Some figures differ by listing: the ADR fell over 7%, while the ordinary share fell 6.5%. Confirm which measure matters before the meeting.

## Open questions

1. What drove the cut to annual revenue growth guidance, and how is management seeing North America demand after the sector slowdown?
2. How much of the $5.2B large-deal TCV will convert to revenue in the next two quarters, and what is the plan to grow AI revenue beyond 10.5% of the total?
3. How is the Pocharam expansion tied to committed client demand, and what is the hiring plan for the new capacity?
